entries.03b5a280c60eb1ba: This business aims to build next-generation financial infrastructure by leveraging digital asset technologies such as stablecoins and tokenized deposits. Jointly with Progmat, it is advancing the cross-border stablecoin remittance infrastructure project “Project Pax” and conducting demonstration tests with financial institutions in Japan and overseas. This business is carried out by consolidated subsidiary Datachain (99.0% of voting rights owned). In the fiscal year ended September 2025, no revenue from external customers was recorded, and the business is at the stage of upfront investment in product development.

entries.0d618ecaef45b513: This business examines and demonstrates the social implementation of tokenized deposits using blockchain technology. It is working on demonstrations of record management models for funds and claims, demonstrations of payment and accounting linkage using smart contracts, and demonstrations of AI use aimed at automating the business processes of corporate clients and financial institutions. It started in November 2025, after the end of the fiscal year. Revenue from external customers is not disclosed by service, so no amount is stated.
entries.13ab462fa3df9b7f: A business providing consulting based on data analysis and outsourced advertising operations, among other services. A business handled by consolidated subsidiary ThinQ Healthcare Co., Ltd. Its base is at the head office in Minato-ku, Tokyo. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥5,105 million.
